method: Compare the Haiku verifier's labels with each record's ORIGINAL (unplanted) enricher labels on topic, intent and severity.
interpretation: The verifier caught all 15 planted semantic errors, but it also disagrees with 30% of unplanted records, so a verifier flag means 'look at this', not 'this is wrong'. Code checks (quote, label, range) have no false flags on these 30.
